parameters.name: AccelerationType
parameters.description:
The acceleration type. Valid values:

- play: streaming acceleration.
- publish: stream ingest acceleration.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the acceleration channel to reuse. This parameter is required when Reuse is set to yes.

parameters.name: MaxBandwidth
parameters.description: The acceleration bandwidth. Unit: Mbit/s. This parameter is required when Reuse is set to no.

parameters.name: Reuse
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to reuse an existing acceleration channel. Valid values:
- yes: Reuse an existing acceleration channel.
- no: Create a new acceleration channel.

parameters.name: VideoCenter
parameters.description: The live center. Valid values: cn-beijing, cn-shanghai, cn-shenzhen, cn-qingdao, ap-northeast-1, ap-southeast-5, eu-central-1, ap-southeast-1, and ap-south-1, which represent the live centers in Beijing, Shanghai, Shenzhen, Qingdao, Japan, Indonesia, Germany, and Singapore respectively.
